name: @veyq/e2e
//: Lane L1's browser suite (ADR 0090, ADR 0091 decision 3): drives admin-web and web in Chromium against an instance booted from the release candidate's own image and compose recipe. It imports nothing from src/web/ or src/admin-web/ — it sees them only as a browser does — and @veyq/crypto only to read back what the browser produced (the Emergency Kit's Secret Key), which is why it is a workspace member (ADR 0090 decision 4). Started by scripts/run_stack_e2e.py inside the pinned Playwright image on the run's compose network, never on the host and never against a dev stack.
//playwright: Pinned EXACTLY, not by range: the browser it drives is the one baked into the Playwright image tests/e2e/stack/docker-compose.e2e.yml pins by digest, and a library one patch apart from its browser fails at launch ('Executable doesn't exist'). scripts/run_stack_e2e.py refuses a run whose installed @playwright/test is not the image's version. Bump both together.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run spec-urls && npm run shards && npm run list
